turns.user_utterance: I was trying to purchase something at the store today and my card has been declined.  Why has this happened?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—card payments being declined at the store are usually due to something like insufficient funds, the merchant not accepting the card, a temporary security block, or the transaction being outside your card’s limits. To pinpoint the cause, can you tell me whether the terminal showed a specific message (e.g., “declined” / “try again later”) and whether you’ve tried making the same purchase again?
